name: Cache pakietów Linux
description: Reports apt's download cache size and orphaned-package/old-snap-revision candidates (unprivileged, read-only), then cleans them via the privileged broker. v1 covers apt and snap only — pacman isn't installed on the dev machine this was built on (untestable, deliberately left out rather than shipped unverified), and flatpak's unused-runtime cleanup has no safe unprivileged preview mechanism yet
